# Kenney scenery

Selected original assets under CC0 1.0. Each directory includes its upstream license.

- [city-kit-commercial](https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial) · [Kenney upload](https://opengameart.org/content/city-kit-commercial) · [ZIP](https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/kenney_city-kit-commercial_2.1.zip): `building-b.glb`, `building-d.glb`, `building-e.glb`, `building-i.glb`, `building-k.glb`, `building-m.glb`.
- [city-kit-industrial](https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-industrial) · [Kenney upload](https://opengameart.org/content/city-kit-industrial) · [ZIP](https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/kenney_city-kit-industrial_2.0.zip): `building-c.glb`, `building-i.glb`, `building-k.glb`, `building-s.glb`.
- [city-kit-roads](https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads) · [Kenney upload](https://opengameart.org/content/city-kit-roads) · [ZIP](https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/kenney_city-kit-roads_2.2.zip): `road-straight.glb`, `road-straight-barrier.glb`, `light-square.glb`, `road-sign-warning.glb`.
- [nature-kit](https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit) · [Kenney upload](https://opengameart.org/content/nature-kit) · [ZIP](https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/Nature%20Kit%20%282.1%29.zip): `tree_oak.glb`, `tree_default.glb`, `fence_simpleLow.glb`.
- [building-kit](https://kenney.nl/assets/building-kit) · [Kenney upload](https://opengameart.org/content/building-kit) · [ZIP](https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/kenney_building-kit.zip): `floor.glb`, `column-wide.glb`, `roof-flat-patch-large.glb`, `wall-window-wide-square-detailed.glb`.

The station is assembled in the game from Building Kit parts. No complete station model is claimed.
